description: Luxury and exotic cars for sale on duPont REGISTRY (US/Canada dealer inventory): newest listings for a brand or brand+model with year, make, model, price (USD, null = call for price), mileage, VIN, stock no., condition, colours, dealer and city, listing link, plus the total matching count and per-model counts. First result page only (about 17 newest listings). Commercial marketplace data, not an official registry. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

brand.description: Brand slug, e.g. ferrari, porsche, lamborghini, mercedes-benz; 'all' for every brand

model.description: Optional model slug as used on the site, e.g. purosangue, 911, huracan
